versions.name: Camp Workcoeman

features.note: A showers building serving the campsites.
Cabins available for year-round unit camping alongside campsites.
All meals are prepared and served in the dining hall.
Nature exploration, conservation projects, and night nature hikes.
The Arrow of Light Adventure Trek, an overnight hike into the backwoods of camp with a fire-cooked meal.
Scouts attending without their pack's leaders are given camp-arranged adult supervision.
A camp store selling snacks, camp merchandise, and Scouting America insignia.
Swimming, boating, and a boathouse on West Hill Pond.

versions.summary: Cub Scout overnight resident camp operated by the Connecticut Rivers Council on West Hill Pond in New Hartford, Connecticut.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored website is the Cub Scout fee page, so the camp's Cub Scout summer camp page and its programme guide were used instead.
